questions.text: The roots of [latex]ax^2+bx+c=0[/latex] are real and positive.  [latex]a,b \text{ and } c[/latex] are real. Then [latex]ax^2+b|x|+c=0[/latex] has
questions.solution:
For x [latex]\ge[/latex] 0, [latex]ax^2+b|x|+c=0[/latex] is the original equation, with its 2 positive roots. For x [latex]\lt[/latex] 0 it becomes [latex]ax^2-bx+c=0[/latex], whose roots are the negatives of those. So there are 4 real roots: [latex]\pm r_1,\pm r_2[/latex].

Answer: 4 real roots

questions.text: In a press meet on the recent scam, the minister said, "The buck stops here". What did the minister convey by the statement?
questions.solution:
"The buck stops here" means the speaker accepts final responsibility and will not pass it on.

Answer: He will assume final responsibility

questions.text:
Choose the most appropriate word from the options given below to complete the following sentence.

He could not understand the judges awarding her the first prize, because he thought that her performance was quite _________.
questions.solution:
He could not understand the award because he thought her performance was ordinary: mediocre.

Answer: mediocre

questions.text:
Which of the following options is the closest in meaning to the phrase in bold in the sentence below?

It is fascinating to see life forms **cope with** varied environmental conditions.
questions.solution:
To cope with conditions is to adapt to them. (Adopt = take up, adept = skilled.)

Answer: Adapt to
